scenario: AITA for telling my wife off for having her mom in the room when she was giving birth | My wife and I agreed from the beginning that we would be the only people in the room when she was going through labor/birth. She cried and blamed me for being late and then told me she wouldn’t discuss it further because I had yelled. AITA here??
